tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand constant, exact from `logomark-ink-1024.png`; the same in every theme. In UI reach for the roles it feeds (`text`, `ground`, `on-signal`); use it directly only where the colour must not flip, such as the mark on a fixed Off-white ground.

tokens.name: brand-offwhite
tokens.usage: Brand constant, exact from `logomark-offwhite-1024.png`; the same in every theme. Feeds `ground`, `text` and `on-accent`. It is the brand's white: never substitute #ffffff.

tokens.name: brand-blueprint
tokens.usage: Brand constant, exact from `logomark-blueprint-1024.png`. The lead colour. 5.2:1 on Off-white but 2.8:1 on Ink, so as text use `text-accent`, which shifts in the Dark theme.

tokens.name: brand-signal
tokens.usage: Brand constant, exact from `logomark-signal-1024.png`. The alert colour. 5.8:1 on Ink but 2.5:1 on Off-white, so as text use `text-signal`, which shifts in the Light theme.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Off-white in Light, Ink in Dark.

tokens.name: ground-well
tokens.usage: Code blocks, table heads and input wells, set slightly into `ground`. Derived, not from the brand files: 6% of the opposite neutral mixed into the ground.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings and the mark, on `ground` (14.7:1 in both themes) and `ground-well` (13.0:1 Light, 12.8:1 Dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions and every `label`, on `ground` (5.4:1 Light, 5.2:1 Dark) and `ground-well` (4.7:1 Light, 4.5:1 Dark). Derived: Dark is Off-white at 55% over Ink; Light is Ink at 66% over Off-white, because 55% there is only 3.8:1.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Links, selected states and icons that act, on `ground` (5.2:1 Light, 5.7:1 Dark) and `ground-well` (4.6:1 Light, 4.9:1 Dark). Blueprint itself in Light; in Dark a lighter Blueprint of the same hue, derived because Blueprint is 2.8:1 on Ink.

tokens.name: text-signal
tokens.usage: Attention copy (errors, warnings, live status) on `ground` (5.2:1 Light, 5.8:1 Dark) and `ground-well` (4.6:1 Light, 5.1:1 Dark), always beside a word or icon that says what is wrong. Signal itself in Dark; in Light a darker Signal of the same hue, derived because Signal is 2.5:1 on Off-white.

tokens.name: fill-accent
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary action in a view, selected rows and progress. Exact Blueprint in both themes; label it with `on-accent`.

tokens.name: fill-signal
tokens.usage: Fill of alert banners, status tags and highlights that need attention now. Exact Signal in both themes; label it with `on-signal`. Never decoration.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `fill-accent` (5.2:1). Off-white, not white.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `fill-signal` (5.8:1). Always Ink: white on Signal is only 3.1:1.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, buttons and anything a person can press or type in, on `ground` and `ground-well`. Full strength (14.7:1), like the mark's own line.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers, table rules and card edges. Decorative only (1.3:1 Light, 1.5:1 Dark): never the sole edge of a control. Derived: 16% of the opposite neutral mixed into the ground.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: solid, `stroke-heavy` wide, offset by `stroke-heavy`, on `ground` and `ground-well` (at least 4.6:1 in both themes).

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Inter 600 tracked -0.01em. The lockup's wordmark is Inter Bold, outlined, and sits outside the scale.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The title of a page or slide. One per view.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Row and list titles, and emphasis inside `body`.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter 400, untracked. `label` echoes the lockup's STUDIO line as a UI style.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ink on Off-white by day, Off-white on Ink by night. Blueprint leads; Signal waits for what needs attention.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Blueprint reads on Off-white at 5.2:1. Signal reads on Ink at 5.8:1.
styles.usage: Dense UI: tables, forms, captions and secondary copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, column heads and field labels. Always capitals, always `text-muted`, never a sentence. The lockup sets STUDIO in the same weight, tracked wider at 0.18em and in full ink; `label` keeps 0.106em, which suits dense UI.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: JetBrains Mono 400 for anything a machine produced.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks (on `ground-well`) and inline code in `body`.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Addresses, hashes, selectors and amounts in tables and metadata; sits beside `body-sm`.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Use these steps only; nothing in between.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The grid unit. Icon-to-label gap; between a `label` and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Vertical padding inside controls; gap between items in a tight row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside controls; between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; column gutters; page margin on a phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section. Also the mark's own grid: it is drawn on 24 units.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop and the break before a new chapter of a page.

radius.note: Square. The mark is drawn with mitred joins, so nothing in the system is rounded.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner: buttons, inputs, cards, tags, images, focus outlines.

stroke.note: Lines do the work shadows do elsewhere. The system has no elevation.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers and card edges in `border-subtle`; control outlines in `border`. The UI's counterpart of the mark's line, which is 0.75 units: 1px when the mark is 32px.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: The focus outline in `border-focus` (and its offset); the underline of the selected tab; drawn lines at display scale.
